style_3_monograph.summary: Warts are growths on your skin caused by an infection with humanpapilloma virus, or HPV . Types of warts include : Common warts, which often appear on your fingers Plantar warts, which show up on the soles of your feet Genital warts , which are a sexually transmitted infection (STI) Flat warts, which appear in places you shave frequently In children, warts often go away on their own. In adults, they tend to stay. If they hurt or bother you, or if they multiply, you can remove them. Chemical skin treatments usually work. If not, various freezing, surgical and laser treatments can remove warts.
style_3_monograph.treatment: Consult healthcare provider for individualized management.

approved_molecules.name: SALICYLIC ACID
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: Key additive in many skin-care products for the treatment of acne, psoriasis, callouses, corns, keratosis pilaris and warts.

approved_molecules.name: ADAPALENE
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: Adapalene is a topical retinoid that is FDA-approved for treating acne vulgaris. Like other retinoids, adapalene has been used off-label for various skin conditions, including verrucae, molluscum contagiosum, Darier disease, Fox-Fordyce disease, Dowling-Degos disease, photoaging,...

approved_molecules.name: GLUTARALDEHYDE
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: For the topical treatment of warts, especially plantar warts.

approved_molecules.name: ACETIC ACID
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: MEDICATION (Vet): Vesicant, caustic, destructive of warts.

approved_molecules.name: LACTIC ACID
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: A 10% solution is used as a bactericidal agent on the skin of neonates. ... A 16.7% solution in flexible collodion is used to remove warts and small cutaneous tumors.

approved_molecules.name: PODOPHYLLOTOXIN
approved_molecules.indication_snippet: For treatment of external genital warts (Condyloma acuminatum).
